channel.title: GPU Tweak III | Ultimate GPU Tuning Tool | ASUS
channel.description: ASUS GPU Tweak III: one-click Overclocking Utility for NVIDIA GeForce and AMD Radeon graphics cards. GPU Tweak enables complete control over 3D graphics performance and monitoring. New features and UI designs from our enthusiastic community are continually added through frequent updates. The result is an extremely intuitive and capable utility. - Powered by RSSHub

item.title: v2.0.3.2
item.description:
1. New: Power Detector+ UI update (supports BTF moderboard models)

  2. Fixed: Fan curve display issue when switching between dual Graphics cards.

  3. Fixed: Incorrect fan naming when using dual Graphics cards.

  4. Fixed: Issue where 0 dB function was not disabled when setting one fan of a dual-fan graphics card to user-defined mode.

  5. Fixed: Inconsistency in fan naming between the Home page and Monitor page for DUAL-RTX5060Ti series graphics cards.

  6. Fixed: OSD showing CPU clock as 0 MHz.

item.title: v2.0.0.1
item.description:
⚫   Fixed: On some older NVIDIA graphics cards, using features such as OC Mode or setting the memory clock could cause a black-screen error.

⚫   Fixed: Resolved layout issues in OSD WIZARD that occurred after adjusting user interface scaling.

item.title: v1.9.8.0
item.description:
Bug Fixes (based on backend feedback):

  • OC Scanner: Fixed an issue where the Temperature field in Advanced Settings was unresponsive.
  • VF Curve: Resolved a bug where importing a profile caused voltage and frequency data to be swapped.
  • Connect:
    • Fixed a bug that allowed users to select non-existent applications.
    • Fixed an issue where the On-Screen Display failed to respond correctly; now the OSD will reflect the profile selected in Connect, or the active GT3 profile if none is specified.
    • Fixed a crash that occurred when closing the Connect window during game scanning.
  • Profile: Resolved a naming issue—users can no longer create profiles with duplicate names.
  • Mobile: Mobile settings now sync properly when updating GPU Tweak III while Mobile features are active.
  • Blacklist: The selected app in the Blacklist section is now automatically checked after selection.
  • External Fans: Fixed an issue where the fan curve would disappear. Auto Fan Calibration for external fans also now allows setting target temperatures below 60°C when using models with 4-pin cables.
  • OSD Wizard:
    • Fixed full-screen display issues with screen resolution previews.
    • Fixed layout issues caused by adjusting scale or font size, which previously led to incorrect text spacing.
  • Fixed an issue where the screen would freeze when enabling Vulkan NVIDIA DLSS-G in the game DOOM: The Dark Ages.

 

Feature Updates:

  • Improved AMD Memory Clock value display when adjusting with arrow keys.
  • Added a shortcut to the FAQ in the Power Detector+ warning popup.

item.title: v1.9.6.4
item.description:
．Fixed: Users had to manually toggle the Blacklist feature again to view the list.

．Fixed: Duplicate entries could be added to the Blacklist.

．Fixed: OC Scanner curve would disappear in some cases.

．Fixed: After adjusting the voltage-frequency curve, modifying the power target and memory clock, then adjusting the power target again, the memory clock would reset to its default speed.

．Fixed: DirectX installation for the OSD is now set as default.

．Known Issue: Launching DOOM with GPU Tweak III's OSD feature enabled may cause a crash. As a temporary workaround, DOOM has been added to the OSD blacklist. A permanent fix is in progress. If you need to monitor system metrics while playing DOOM, please use the Mobile View feature under the Monitor tab as an alternative.

item.title: v1.9.5.8
item.description:
• Added: Mobile Control feature, empowering users to control toggles and switch mode via a mobile device.
  • Fixed: Power Detector+ showed false alerts after sleep due to reading the current as 0A.
  • Fixed: Crash issue when switching between OSD profiles.
  • Fixed: OSD blacklist not functioning correctly.
  • Fixed: Incorrect product name display for GeForce RTX 5090 and 5090D series liquid-cooled graphics cards.
  • Updated: GPU-Z version is now 2.65.0.
